evidence.observation: Holding at 750.3 °C against a 750 °C setpoint after a small overshoot (760.5 °C) at the start of growth; the ramp tracked its setpoint closely.
Ar flow 99.9 sccm against a 100 sccm setpoint; steady throughout.
Pressure steady at about 760.5 Torr; no sign of a leak or a blocked exhaust.
Heater power settled at about 46% in the hold, which fits with the temperature readings.
Sensor not installed (per the device manifest), so the growth-stage atmosphere check cannot be done.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or another independent check of the atmosphere, such as a leak test) to confirm the growth atmosphere is oxygen-free; after that, characterization of the sample.
